cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women and postnatal mothers aged 18 to 40 years.
finding: The study found that 96% of cases requiring blood transfusion experienced no transfusion-related complications, though 7% were observed with surgical site infection.
mod_finding: The Caesarean section rate in the study population was 39%, with emergency LSCS cases constituting the majority (26%).
gest_age: The majority of the study population belonged to the Second Trimester (42%), followed by the Third Trimester (40%) and First Trimester (15%) at the time of the event.
